newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Aitken Spence up 4 pct on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Aitken Spence up 4 pct on foreign buying.

text.p: Overseas buying of Aitken Spence & Co Ltd pushed up the shares by four percent, or five rupees, to 130 on Friday, brokers said.
"The share is very good value at current levels, because it hit over 300 rupees when the market rallied in 1994," said a trader with a foreign joint venture.
A total of 165,000 shares changed hands, brokers said.
Aitken Spence is a blue chip holding company with diverse activities ranging from hotels and tourism, printing, garment manufacture and agriculture.
